articles.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by the target model. articles.summary: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. articles.summary: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. articles.summary: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. articles.summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet synthesizing diverse and reliable software environments at scale remains challenging. articles.title: Recurrent Harness for Agentic Continual Learning
articles.summary: Language model agents increasingly operate over long interaction streams, requiring online adaptation to distribution shifts through continual learning. articles.summary: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. articles.summary: Foundation models can serve as clinical agents through tool-use harnesses. articles.summary: Efficient visual tokenization requires balancing representation compactness with the preservation of fine-grained image content. articles.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for graph understanding and decision-making, while System One models such as Jev select directly from supplied options. articles.summary: Visual representations are largely developed for understanding, yet what makes them useful for generation remains unclear. articles.summary: Recent joint video-audio generation models have achieved strong semantic correspondence and temporal synchronization. articles.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a target policy on its own rollouts using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, but typically relies on the teacher being substantially more capable than the target. articles.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. articles.summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on AMLworld's smallest test splits is costly because each of over a million targets requires a separate graph prompt. articles.summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. articles.summary: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. articles.summary: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas.
